text:
Maya: Quick poll — anyone want to hit the boulder wall at 12:15? Or a short 12-minute EMOM in the multipurpose room? Vote with emoji: :climbing_man: = boulder, :stopwatch: = EMOM, :heart: = both.
Zhang: I can make 12:15 for boulder. Haven't climbed in a bit, so a few easy routes pls. What pass do we use?
Carlos: Company discount still works at Gravity Loop — show badge at the desk, might take 5-10 mins to check in.
Amanda: EMOM sounds tempting but my shoulder's a little cranky. Could we do mostly lower-body & pulling? :grimacing:
Maya: Maybe split it — 12:15–12:35 quick boulder pickups, then 12:40–12:52 EMOM (12 minutes). Short, sweaty, and nobody misses lunch.
Zhang: Works for me. Is there a mat available for floor stuff? I can bring one.
Carlos: I'll bring a 16kg kettlebell + extra water. EMOM plan?
Amanda: Bodyweight-friendly EMOM suggestion: ```EMOM 12
0: 10 push-ups (knees ok)
1: 12 air squats
2: 8 ring rows or inverted rows
repeat until 12 min``` Keeps it shoulder-sensitive and scalable.
FitBot: Reminder set — 12:05 "Boulder/EMOM group meetup at Lobby" :bell: (automated)
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll bring chalk + tape. Also we can rotate partners on routes so everyone gets beta.
Amanda: Count me in. Rotate partners + short warmup before the first route. :muscle:
Carlos: Coffee after? There's a new espresso blend at the cafe if anyone's up for it. ☕
